entries: flirt shamelessly with whoever speaks to you next
maintain lingering eye contact with whoever you're speaking to. Hold it a beat too long every time
speak to whoever is across from you like you're trying to get their number
every compliment you give must have a physical quality in it
whenever you address the person on your left, lower your voice like it's a private conversation
respond to everything the person on your right says like you find it genuinely attractive
treat every question someone asks you like it's an invitation
describe anything you like or enjoy like it's something you'd whisper to someone at 2am
every time someone makes you laugh, tell them it's your favorite thing about them so far
speak to the person directly across from you like the two of you already have a secret worth sneaking off to share
every time you make a point, end it by asking the person across from you if they agree, and hold the eye contact until they answer
start every sentence to someone on your right with a compliment about something specific you've noticed about them tonight
whenever the person on your left talks, lean in a little closer like you don't want to miss a word
tell whoever you're speaking to that you weren't expecting them to be your type, and mean it
every time you agree with the person across from you, make it sound like the two of you are dangerously compatible
whenever you catch the eye of the person on your right, hold it a second longer than a normal glance, then smile like you got caught
tell the person on your left one thing about tonight that you're going to be thinking about later
whenever the person across from you laughs, tell them you like them best when they're like this
